deny.quote: Exit code `2` - Block the action (equivalent to returning `permission: "deny"`) ; Output { "permission": "allow" | "deny" | "ask", "user_message": "<message shown in client>", "agent_message": "<message sent to agent>" }

gaps: Exit-2 stderr model visibility not documented; JSON agent_message is the documented model-visible channel
